review.why: Draft marketing content from channel templates: blog, social, newsletter, landing page, press release and case study, with SEO basics, hooks and CTAs.
review.summary: Structures and rules for six content types, writing practices by channel, an on-page SEO checklist, headline and hook formulas and call-to-action guidance. It is marked not user-invocable, so it loads as background guidance for other content requests.
strengths: Concrete structures with length guides for each content type, including press release and case study.
Compact rules for CTA wording and placement and for on-page SEO.
Headline and hook formulas, each with an example.
cautions: Generic by design: it gives structure, not your brand voice or research, so pair it with a voice guide.
Figures such as character counts and reading level are rules of thumb that change by platform.
The repository's LICENSE file is the Apache-2.0 text followed by unrelated stray text, so the license shows as unclear although GitHub detects Apache-2.0. Read in full but not run here.
